differences.title: 1. CORE TECHNOLOGY
differences.leftDesc: Neutralinojs utilizes the operating system's native web rendering engine, keeping the application size extremely small and leveraging existing system resources.
differences.rightDesc: Electron bundles a full Chromium browser instance with Node.js, providing a consistent rendering environment but significantly increasing application size and memory footprint.

differences.title: 2. APPLICATION SIZE
differences.leftDesc: Neutralinojs apps typically result in a single, very small executable (few MBs) as they don't bundle UI frameworks or browser engines.
differences.rightDesc: Electron apps are notoriously large (tens to hundreds of MBs) due to the inclusion of Chromium and Node.js runtime environments.

differences.title: 3. MEMORY USAGE
differences.leftDesc: By using the native engine, Neutralinojs apps consume significantly less RAM, making them ideal for resource-constrained environments or older hardware.
differences.rightDesc: Electron apps require more memory as they initialize a full browser instance, even for simple applications, leading to higher overall RAM consumption.

differences.title: 4. DEVELOPMENT SIMPLICITY
differences.leftDesc: Neutralinojs offers a straightforward JavaScript API for interacting with native functionalities, simplifying the development process for basic desktop features.
differences.rightDesc: Electron provides a rich API surface with extensive modules for native integration, which can be powerful but also complex to master fully.

differences.title: 5. NATIVE INTEGRATION
differences.leftDesc: Neutralinojs relies on native OS APIs exposed through its lightweight JavaScript interface, offering direct access to system functionalities.
differences.rightDesc: Electron leverages Node.js APIs for backend operations and a rich set of Chrome APIs for frontend-backend communication, offering broad capabilities.

differences.title: 6. CROSS-PLATFORM
differences.leftDesc: Neutralinojs allows you to write your UI once using web technologies and deploy it across Windows, macOS, and Linux using native rendering.
differences.rightDesc: Electron provides a consistent cross-platform development experience by bundling its own rendering engine and Node.js runtime.

differences.title: 7. PERFORMANCE
differences.leftDesc: Neutralinojs boasts significantly faster application startup times due to its minimal footprint and reliance on existing system resources.
differences.rightDesc: Electron applications can have a noticeable delay during startup because of the time required to initialize the bundled Chromium browser.
